      OR ("audit_entries"."event_id" IS NULL AND "audit_entries"."action" = 'identity.orcid.connected' AND "audit_entries"."resource_id" = "audit_entries"."person_id"

review_file_read.using: "work_files"."organization_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.organization_id', true), '')::uuid AND "work_files"."event_id"=nullif(current_setting('sep.event_id',true),'')::uuid AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM review_assignments a JOIN review_rounds r ON r.id=a.round_id WHERE a.organization_id="work_files"."organization_id" AND a.event_id="work_files"."event_id" AND a.work_id="work_files"."work_id" AND a.reviewer_id=nullif(current_setting('sep.person_id',true),'')::uuid AND a.status IN ('accepted','submitted') AND a.content->'manuscript'->>'id'="work_files"."id"::text AND r.status='open' AND sep_review_available("work_files"."organization_id","work_files"."event_id","work_files"."work_id",r.version_id,false))

file_read.name: file_read
file_read.using: "work_files"."organization_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.organization_id', true), '')::uuid AND "work_files"."event_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.event_id',true),'')::uuid AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM author_works w WHERE w.id="work_files"."work_id" AND w.organization_id="work_files"."organization_id" AND w.event_id="work_files"."event_id") AND (current_setting('sep.submissions_staff',true) IS DISTINCT FROM 'true' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM work_versions v WHERE v.file_id="work_files"."id" AND v.work_id="work_files"."work_id"))

file_insert.name: file_insert
file_insert.withCheck: "work_files"."organization_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.organization_id', true), '')::uuid AND "work_files"."event_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.event_id',true),'')::uuid AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM author_works w WHERE w.id="work_files"."work_id" AND w.organization_id="work_files"."organization_id" AND w.event_id="work_files"."event_id") AND "work_files"."owner_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.person_id', true), '')::uuid

file_delete.name: file_delete
file_delete.using: current_setting('sep.submissions_staff',true) IS DISTINCT FROM 'true' AND "work_files"."organization_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.organization_id', true), '')::uuid AND "work_files"."event_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.event_id',true),'')::uuid AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM author_works w WHERE w.id="work_files"."work_id" AND w.organization_id="work_files"."organization_id" AND w.event_id="work_files"."event_id") AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM work_versions v WHERE v.file_id="work_files"."id")

authorship_rpc.name: authorship_rpc
authorship_rpc.withCheck: current_setting('sep.authorship_rpc',true)='true' AND "work_history"."organization_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.organization_id', true), '')::uuid AND "work_history"."event_id"=nullif(current_setting('sep.event_id',true),'')::uuid AND "work_history"."actor_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.person_id', true), '')::uuid

history_read.name: history_read
history_read.using: "work_history"."organization_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.organization_id', true), '')::uuid AND "work_history"."event_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.event_id',true),'')::uuid AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM author_works w WHERE w.id="work_history"."work_id" AND w.organization_id="work_history"."organization_id" AND w.event_id="work_history"."event_id") AND (current_setting('sep.submissions_staff',true) IS DISTINCT FROM 'true' OR "work_history"."actor"='staff' OR "work_history"."action" IN ('submitted','final_submitted','withdrawn'))

history_insert.name: history_insert
history_insert.withCheck: "work_history"."organization_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.organization_id', true), '')::uuid AND "work_history"."event_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.event_id',true),'')::uuid AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM author_works w WHERE w.id="work_history"."work_id" AND w.organization_id="work_history"."organization_id" AND w.event_id="work_history"."event_id") AND "work_history"."actor_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.person_id', true), '')::uuid

context_scope.name: context_scope
context_scope.using: "work_notice_reads"."person_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.person_id', true), '')::uuid AND "work_notice_reads"."organization_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.organization_id', true), '')::uuid AND "work_notice_reads"."event_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.event_id',true),'')::uuid AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM author_works w WHERE w.id="work_notice_reads"."work_id" AND w.organization_id="work_notice_reads"."organization_id" AND w.event_id="work_notice_reads"."event_id")
context_scope.withCheck: "work_notice_reads"."person_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.person_id', true), '')::uuid AND "work_notice_reads"."organization_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.organization_id', true), '')::uuid AND "work_notice_reads"."event_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.event_id',true),'')::uuid AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM author_works w WHERE w.id="work_notice_reads"."work_id" AND w.organization_id="work_notice_reads"."organization_id" AND w.event_id="work_notice_reads"."event_id")

version_read.name: version_read
version_read.using: "work_versions"."organization_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.organization_id', true), '')::uuid AND "work_versions"."event_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.event_id',true),'')::uuid AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM author_works w WHERE w.id="work_versions"."work_id" AND w.organization_id="work_versions"."organization_id" AND w.event_id="work_versions"."event_id")

version_insert.name: version_insert
version_insert.withCheck: "work_versions"."organization_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.organization_id', true), '')::uuid AND "work_versions"."event_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.event_id',true),'')::uuid AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM author_works w WHERE w.id="work_versions"."work_id" AND w.organization_id="work_versions"."organization_id" AND w.event_id="work_versions"."event_id") AND "work_versions"."owner_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.person_id', true), '')::uuid
